verse.verse_1: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
verse.verse_2: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
verse.verse_4: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
verse.verse_5: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
verse.verse_6: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
verse.verse_7: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
verse.verse_8: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
verse.verse_11: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
verse.verse_12: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
verse.verse_13: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
verse.verse_17: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
verse.verse_18: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
verse.verse_19: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
verse.verse_20: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
verse.verse_21: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
verse.verse_22: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
verse.verse_23: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
verse.verse_24: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
verse.verse_25: For to Us will be their return;
verse.verse_26: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
